name: Llobera (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a black bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with two blue six-pointed stars at the upper fly and the lower hoist.
history: The official flag of Llobera is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with a black bend of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth and two blue six-pointed stars, each of diameter 1/6 of the height; approved on 21 December 2009 and published in the DOGC on 5 January 2010.

features.role: bend of 1/6 of the height from the upper hoist to the lower fly
